Training Thursday: Train your nervous system BEFORE the fight starts. You cannot learn calm in the middle of an argument. Step 1: catch your tell, the heat in your chest or the set jaw, the 3 seconds before you react. Step 2: name it out loud when things are calm. Step 3: pause with a promise: 'I want to get this right, not win it. Give me 10 minutes and we finish.' A trained partner is not the one who never gets heated, he is the one whose body does not make his decisions.
